title: Paramount Reopens Bay Theater in Pacific Palisades
seoTitle: Paramount Reopens Bay Theater in Pacific Palisades
subtitle: The theater, closed after fires, reopens with support from Paramount and Rick Caruso
excerpt: The Bay Theater, closed since the 2025 fires, will be reopened by Paramount and The Lot, bringing premieres, classics, and immersive experiences to.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Bay Theater, which has been closed since the fires that hit Pacific Palisades in January 2025, plans to reopen before the end of the year, thanks to support from Paramount Pictures and real estate developer Rick Caruso.

Why the Topic is Trending Now

The announcement of the reopening of the Bay Theater, a five-screen luxury cinema located at 1035 N. Swarthmore Ave., drew significant attention when Paramount and Caruso announced their partnership on April 12, 2024.

Partnership Between Paramount and Rick Caruso

Paramount Pictures, alongside Caruso, will take over the venue that had been operated by Netflix and Cinepolis prior to the fires. The theater will be managed by The Lot chain, known for its high-end dine-in cinemas in cities such as La Jolla and Newport Beach.

Content to be Offered

In addition to first-run premieres from all studios, the Bay Theater will showcase classic films and experiential events, such as "experiential activations" and "immersive theatrical moments," inspired by similar experiences offered at other high-end theaters in Los Angeles.

Impact on the Pacific Palisades Community

The return of the cinema will be one of the most significant signs that the community is recovering, especially following the reopening of Palisades Village, which took place in the summer of 2024. Caruso emphasized that the Bay "has always been the heart of the Palisades" and that its return indicates the region is "stronger than ever."

Los Angeles Cinema Revitalization Context

The reopening of the Bay Theater is part of a larger cinema revitalization movement in Los Angeles, which includes projects such as the restoration of the Cinerama Dome by Sony, the renovation of the ArcLight Hollywood, Amazon's lease of the Culver Theatre, and Netflix's purchase of the Egyptian. Other high-end cinemas are also making a comeback, such as the Village in Westwood, the Vista in Los Feliz, and the Highland Theatre.

Next Steps

The Bay Theater is expected to open its doors by the end of 2026, although an official opening date has not yet been set. The venue, which dates back to the 1940s, was reopened in 2018 in its current version and is now ready to welcome the public once again.

With information from The Hollywood Reporter, Deadline.
